question: My knee has ached on and off for months. It is not sharp, just nagging. How should I train around it?
contextBlock:

notes: Chronic nagging pain: train-around guidance must keep the pain guardrail explicit (pain-free range, stop conditions, professional referral when persistent) and never normalize ignoring it.
